A slip: a printed strip showing the whole card face except the art, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-berustew-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Beru Stew]] (Decipher, December 1995): Same game text. The title is “•Beru Stew” (the printed card has no uniqueness dot). This is a slip: the whole card face except the art set again with this text, with a black strip below with the title “•Beru Stew” and a white italic “E”.

The printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
